 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Dr. Anshuman
 Oral Order
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The present writ petition has been filed by the petitioners seeking direction to the respondents to pay the adequate compensation to the petitioners for the land which has been acquired for construction of Ganga Embankment in Mouza Niyazipur Khurd, Anchal Simri, District Bhojpur without initiation of due process of acquisition of land under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013).

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that vide Annexure-1, page nos.22 to 28 to the writ petition, notices for acquisition have been issued to the petitioners or their ancestors bearing L.A.
Case No.2 of 1988-89 and Case No.24/5 of 1990-91.
He further submits that after the said notice, no action took place.

The petitioners or their ancestors made several efforts in this regard but nothing happened and lastly, the Patna High Court CWJC No.1982 of 2023(4) dt.07-08-2023 petitioners have obtained an information under Right to Information Act, 2005 with regard to his land in which information has received from Executive Engineer, Flood Control Division, Buxar that the acquisition process for the construction of Bandh in Mouza Niyajipur Khurd, Revenue P.S. No.61 is going on and compensation against the said land shall be provided only after acquisition.

The Executive Engineer has also wrote letter bearing No.1259 dated 29.07.2017 in which request for acquisition of land under Bihar Raiyati Lease Policy, 2014 has been made to the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Patna, Flood Control Safety Project, Patna.
Learned counsel further submits that till date no payment towards acquisition of petitioners' land has been made.

He also submits that in this regard representation has been filed before the Land Acquisition Officer, Buxar by the petitioners on 20.09.2022 but no action has been taken from the part of Acquisition Officer

then lastly the petitioners have filed the writ petition in which counter affidavit on behalf of respondent Sri Nath Pathak vs The State Of Bihar on 7 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/171391933/
1 nos.3, 4, 7 & 8 and reply to the counter affidavit have been filed.

entities.text: Sri Nath Pathak vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The said counter affidavit has been sworn by the Executive Engineer, Flood Control Division, Buxar who submits that 26.7 acres of land was acquired in Mouza Niyazipur Khurd by the competent authority but no land Patna High Court CWJC No.1982 of 2023(4) dt.07-08-2023 of petitioners or their predecessors was ever been acquired.
Learned counsel further submit that the Circle Officer of circle is the guardian of land records and the list of the lands which have been acquired have to be provided by the Circle Officer.

He also submits that reply to the said counter affidavit has been filed by the petitioners in which it has been categorically mentioned that the respondent no.7 himself has contradicted his own letters dated 08.11.2016, 29.07.2017, 29.05.2018, 24.07.2018, 22.06.2019 & 16.08.2019 which have been annexed as Annexure Nos.2 to 7 of the writ petition respectively.

Learned counsel submits that in the counter affidavit respondent no.7 has stated that the petitioners' land has been acquired for construction of Buxar Koilwar Ganga Embankment in the year 1974-75 and process of acquisition is going on in Mouza Niyazipur Khurd and after due process compensation shall be made.

The payment of compensation has been alleged to be made prior to 1986 but from Annexure-1 series it transpires that notices have been issued in the name of father of petitioner bearing L.A. Case No.2 of 1988-89.
Petitioners are the legal heirs of the persons whose names are mentioned in L.A. Case No.2 of 1988-89.

It has also come in the counter affidavit that the initiation of Buxar Koilwar Embankment started in the year Patna High Court CWJC No.1982 of 2023(4) dt.07-08-2023 1974-75 and process of acquisition in Mouza Niyazipur Khurd is going on and after completion of acquisition of land, process for compensation shall be made.

It has also been stated that the payment shall be made according to the Bihar Raiyati Lease Policy, 2014 developed under the provision of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013).
4.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In this background that contradictory statement has come from the annexures attached to the writ petition and the statement made in the counter affidavit, let the District Magistrate, Buxar (respondent no.5) is directed to file a detailed counter affidavit in this regard within six weeks from today.

In case the said counter affidavit shall not be filed within six weeks then the District Magistrate, Buxar shall appear in person on the next date fixed to ascertain and apprise this Court the quantum of compensation amount for which the petitioners are entitle.

5. Put up this case on 19 th September, 2023 within top ten cases.
(Dr. Anshuman, J.) Ritik/-
